postman-reference.png.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create one PNG image, exactly 2048 x 2048 pixels or larger square, a complete assembled cut-out paper puppet character reference.
Subject: a short small-statured adult mail carrier, standing upright, STRICT TRUE SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT. Cap with visor pointing right, one visible open eye, closed mouth, small nose, short body, mail satchel attached behind the hip with strap across torso. Both arms resting down, both feet point right. Readable silhouette. Whole figure fully visible, centered with generous blank margin on all sides.
Style: nineteenth-century children's articulated jumping-jack paper doll printed as a hand-colored woodcut. Irregular confident black ink outlines, simple graphic interior lines, flat muted navy blue uniform and cap, flat brick red satchel, warm ochre skin accents, cream negative spaces. Only 2–3 flat colors plus black and paper. No tonal shading, no gradients, no perspective, no cast shadows, no photographic paper cutout shadows. Warm personality and genuinely old handmade print character.
Background: absolutely uniform solid cream paper color approximately #efe6d2, no texture or speckles in the empty background.
Anatomy suitable for later splitting into head+cap, torso+satchel, upper arms, forearms, hands, thighs, lower legs+shoes. Subtle rounded overlapping joint forms, no pinholes or visible metal fasteners. No writing, letters, labels, numbers, borders, crop marks, dashed lines or scissors lines. Just ONE assembled character, not a parts sheet.

postman-parts.png.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate a new production cut-out animation puppet parts sheet, square PNG 2048x2048.
IMAGE 1 reference.png is the character identity and handmade woodcut style reference. IMAGE 2 parts.png is the previous parts sheet, a layout and component-count reference ONLY. Correct its outlined ball joints. Same little right-facing postman, navy uniform and cap, brick red satchel, warm skin, black shoes, irregular woodcut black outlines and hand-colored printed grain inside the visible clothing and face. Background perfectly flat solid #efe6d2 with no grain, no gradient, no shadows.
EXACTLY 15 separated parts, one common anatomical scale, generous margins and VERY WIDE gaps. Retain four-row arrangement with 3,4,4,4 parts:
Row 1: three heads with cap, strict right profile, identical proportions: eyes open mouth shut, eyes shut mouth shut, eyes open mouth open.
Row 2: armless torso including red mailbag and diagonal strap, two upper arms, one forearm.
Row 3: second forearm, relaxed hanging hand, tightly closed fist, open waving hand oriented VERTICALLY WITH FINGERS DOWN and wrist at top just like the other hands.
Row 4: two thighs, two lower legs each with attached black shoe pointing right.

CRITICAL JOINT ENGINEERING. These are layered animation pieces, NOT a jumping-jack with black-outlined circular knobs. Do not outline the hidden insertion tabs. Each hidden tab is a smooth SOLID COLOR round extension merged directly into its part, without ANY black contour around its rounded end, without an interior ring, without a dividing line across its base, without ink texture. The inked side contours STOP below the tab. The upper overlapping part has the normal outlined silhouette that covers the entire insertion tab when assembled.
- Heads: below each neck extend an UNOUTLINED solid skin-colored round insertion tab. Face/hair remain outlined but the bottom neck tab has absolutely no black rim.
- Torso: normal outlined collar that will cover the neck tab. No ball at neck, shoulder or hem. No attached arms or drawn arm silhouettes. Normal coat hem.
- Both upper arms: natural rounded outlined shoulder at TOP, normal rounded outlined sleeve elbow at BOTTOM. A single sleeve shape, NO smaller separate circular knob at either end, NO internal circles.
- Both forearms: TOP has an unoutlined solid NAVY BLUE round insertion tab to hide under upper arm. Bottom has normal black-outlined cuff, NO extra wrist ball and NO attached hand.
- All three hands: TOP wrist has unoutlined solid SKIN-COLORED round insertion tab to hide inside cuff. Outline the visible hands and fingers, but NOT the wrist insertion tab. All three hang down, including the spread-finger open hand.
- Both thighs: TOP unoutlined solid NAVY BLUE round insertion tab to hide under coat hem. BOTTOM natural rounded black-outlined knee as an integral part of trouser silhouette, NO little circular knob or internal ring.
- Both lower legs: TOP unoutlined solid NAVY BLUE round insertion tab to hide under outlined thigh knee. Below is normal outlined trouser leg and attached black shoe pointing right.
On every unoutlined tab the pure blue or skin fill meets the cream background directly, zero dark border. Round tabs extend enough to overlap, but are continuous with their limb, not isolated balls. Do NOT copy the black rings from image 2.
All components match the reference character and retain worn woodcut hand-colored style. No text, numbering, labels, dashed lines, guides, grid, fasteners, holes, or decorative elements.
